annotations.title: Unzip a file inside a bucket

description: Unpack a .zip that is already in a bucket (up to 100 MB per file inside it, any total size) into a folder in the same bucket, without downloading it. The archive is read in ranges and files are written under dest_prefix (default: the zip name without .zip). Each call works for about 40 seconds; if the result says done is false, call again with start set to next_start. Existing files with the same path are replaced (confirm: true). The zip itself is left in place. Upload the zip first with storage_upload_link or the dashboard.

bucket.description: Bucket name (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens).

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

dest_prefix.description: Folder to unpack into, e.g. "Design_System/files/". Default: next to the zip, named after it.

key.description: Path of the .zip in the bucket.

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

start.description: Entry number to continue from (the previous result's next_start). Default 0.

name: extract_storage_zip
title: Unzip a file inside a bucket
